name: Tashuzokukan Mondai Kaiketsu Iinkai 1
original_name: 多種族間問題解決委員会1
source:
Due to a specific event that occurred on a global scale,
a variety of species from different worlds are living on earth.
There are problems between various species, and to remedy this
the [Multi-Species Relations Problem Solving Committee] was created.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE248960.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
由于一场席卷全球的特殊事件，来自不同世界的各种种族开始生活在地球上。
不同种族之间产生许多问题，于是成立了“多种族关系问题解决委员会”。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE248960.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
